facts.fact: The Bank of Mozambique states that Lei n.o 15/2026 of 2 July approves the National Payments System Law and revokes Lei n.o 2/2008 of 27 February, modernising the framework and strengthening the central bank's oversight and supervisory powers (notice dated 2026-07-16).
facts.system: Lei do Sistema Nacional de Pagamentos (Lei 15/2026)
